comment: Envelope spec for the lighting metering harness (scripts/measure_lighting.js). Poses approved 2026-06-13. Camera states are ThreeScene.setCameraState() payloads; sun and theme are swept per pose. Bounds are PROVISIONAL until anchor frames are blessed (Phase 2).

gamelightReference.note: colour-fidelity mode: load with ?gamelight (decoded az 107.12 / el 7, shadows+districts+pins stripped) and compare against the in-game PIX SDR capture

poses.why: intro rest pose — first impression; doubles as gamelight colour-fidelity + near-max-zoom frame
deep backlit street canyon — 'never too dark' floor; watches the _m slope-fix region
densest towers + landmarks — deepest shadow pools, SHADOW_INTENSITY readout
open water — largest uniform surface, first to clip; exposure ceiling
bare terrain + grid — the docs' clean calibration reference surface
typical browsing altitude — mixed heights, roads/metro/water in one frame
pin-popup working distance at strong tilt — _m detail + edge highlight at full scale
separate district material constants (edge sharpness 50) — calibration generalisation check
